parameters.name: GatewayId
parameters.description: The private gateway ID. To obtain the private gateway ID, see the private_gateway_id parameter in the response parameters of the ListResources operation.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. Default value: 100.

parameters.name: ResourceName
parameters.description: The ID of the resource group. To obtain a resource group ID, see the ResourceId field in the response of the [ListResources](~~412133~~) operation.
